detail.longDescription: For adding initContainers and env variables to K8s deployments, I wrote a configurable webhook which relies on cert-manager for cluster-internal self-generated certificates. For an easy installation on Kubernetes, I started writing a Helm chart in which I'm trying to check if cert-manager is installed or if its API is available, respectively. After having found this entry on StackOverflow, I'm currently using .Capabilities.APIVersions.Has to check if cert-manager is already in place. Here's the respective code snippet from the template yaml: {{- if not (.Capabilities.APIVersions.Has "cert-manager.io/v1") }} {{- fail "\nYou need to install cert-manager first!" }} {{- end }} The code works and on error the installation fails, printing the given message: foo@controlplane:~$ helm install test test Error: INSTALLATION FAILED: execution error at (test/templates/cert-issuer.yaml:15:10): You need to install cert-manager first! foo@controlplane:~$ What is a more elegant way to do a check and, if needed to, stop an installation, e.g. w/o printing the "Error at path/foo.yaml:line:offset" error message? (Because there's no error in the template itself.)
